title: Controls operation.
officialText: Upon activation, the smoke detectors shall shut down all operational capabilities of the air distribution systems serving the affected areas in accordance with the listing and labeling of appliances used in the system. Air distribution systems that are part of a smoke control system shall switch to the smoke control mode upon activation of a detector.
